name: Microservices Gateway
snippet: Client makes request through API Gateway with JWT Auth. Gateway routes to User Service and Order Service. Both connect to Redis Cache and write to PostgreSQL database.

name: OAuth2 PKCE Flow
snippet: Single Page App initiates authorization request with Code Challenge to Auth Server. User consents. Auth Server redirects with Auth Code. SPA exchanges Auth Code and Code Verifier for Access Token.

name: Real-time Event Stream
snippet: IoT sensors stream metrics to Kafka Ingestion Topic. Apache Flink processes sliding window aggregates. Output streams to TimescaleDB and triggers alerts via Webhook.
